text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And now, the moment we've all been
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Our Umamusume of the Year! She's the
brightest
star of the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
With countless triumphs over her
formidable
peers at the G1 level, her
talents truly are
befitting of an empress!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beginning with the Shinzan Kinen, Taiki
Shuttle
has faced every battle head-on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her achievements are recognized by the

association, and she is presented the
award for
best sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the road to becoming
Umamusume of
the Year turns out to be
far more arduous than we
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we should have entered more
races. Or
branched out beyond mile
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We gave it our utmost effort... and yet I
can't
stop thinking about what else we
could have
done.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did ya see what happened at the
press
conference?! Air Groove is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume of the Year, right? Of
course I saw!
She really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But ya know, this year's lineup was
pretty
strong—it could've easily gone to
someone else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's true. There was Grass Wonder in
the junior
division, and Mejiro Dober in
the classic
division...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention Taiki Shuttle in the
sprint division.
Everyone was a
powerhouse in their own right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... power alone doesn't win you the
title of
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was just on another level!
She tore up
the track like nobody's
business!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She snatched everybody's hearts right
outta their
chests to claim the win! So
cool...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect title for someone like me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What the heck are you talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The year's number one Umamusume,
who's
number one in everyone's hearts...
No one else
fits the bill but me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, them's fightin' words! Why don't
we settle
this on the track?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The top Umamusume in everyone's
hearts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy to leave a lasting
impression
through sprint and mile races
alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return to the track, mulling over those

concerns...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get runnin', Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wondered who was trying to bowl me
over... I
should have known it was you,
Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course—I'll be your opponent. Let's
have a
good run.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Fukukitaru! Let's go
running—you and
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki?! What's this all of a sudden?! I was
only
passing by!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then this must be destiny! Talk about
lucky! Now,
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But I have to follow Shiraoki's divine
message!
"Take it easy this afternoon for
good fortu"—wait!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Worked up a good sweat! Now,
who should
my next target be...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I'm outta time! We got ourselves
some
training to do, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle is just as energetic—no, more energetic than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But hard work and a positive mindset
alone won't
get her any closer to
becoming Umamusume of
the Year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Listen up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Can ya do me a favor, please?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I want ya to put me in as many G1
sprints and
miles as ya can rustle up.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll be number one in all of 'em—promise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I ran all those sprints and miles ya
recommended
last year, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And how was I?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wasn't it exciting? Wasn't I fantastic?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bet your boots I was! If ya ask me, I think
I'm
plenty exciting and fantastic right
now too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna win. When it comes
to
speed, there ain't no way I can lose!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll get even stronger and faster! More
and more
and more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Til I reach everybody's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Life is what ya make it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep pushin' forward and
carve out my
own path, even if I'm the
only one to walk it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I'll do it with these trusty legs of
mine—the
ones you never stopped
believing in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who told her that her power
and
speed were unparalleled in the first
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And yet...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So whaddya think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: (If I don't believe in her, who will...?!)
(If I don't believe in her, who will...?!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Do ya still believe in me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaaaw! That's what I like to hear!
choice_data_list: Next time, we'll definitely become "Umamusume of the Year"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! It's definitely
happening next
year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my dream come true! I'm gonna
be
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First things first—we're taking on the
Yasuda
Kinen, the race that crowns the
spring King of the
Mile!
